original_supported_targets.claim: Goodland Kitchen is located at 231 S Magnolia Ave in Goleta, CA.
Goodland Kitchen is a local business offering a range of services including food, shopping, and professional services.
The restaurant specializes in new American cuisine.
Goodland Kitchen operates Monday through Friday from 7:00 am to 2:00 pm.
The establishment does not offer WiFi.
Validated parking is not available, but street parking is available.
The establishment is suitable for groups.
The ambience is casual and classy.
The establishment does not accept reservations.
The business has an overall rating of 3.5 stars.
A review praises the friendly service, great lunch menu, and quality of the takeout food, particularly the chorizo, chips, and salads.
Another reviewer commended their service and food, urging people to support this small business.

A less favorable review noted a decline in the quality and variety of food, dissatisfaction with the bread and soup options, and the absence of the lunch specials previously advertised on their website.
